findings.claim: Goal 'Return control to the parent phase and resume its exact next command' has no corresponding work or command in the plan.
findings.evidence: Goals list 'Return control to the parent phase and resume its exact next command' as a phase goal, but the plan's only command is '/opsx:new repair-sovereign-sync-kbd-availability' and no change detail or acceptance criterion identifies the parent's next command, records it, or schedules its resumption. The scope cuts mention returning the projection-migration 'resolution decision to the parent `openspec-mirror-drift-cleanup` phase' but never address resuming the parent's exact next command.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an explicit completion step (or acceptance item) that captures the parent phase's exact next command from `.kbd-orchestrator/current-waypoint.json`/position state and schedules its resumption after the change archives.

findings.claim: The change detail 'repair the child-runtime orchestration seams encountered during recovery' is unbounded and untestable — it names no files, no seams, and no acceptance criterion covers it.
findings.evidence: Details states 'repair the child-runtime orchestration seams encountered during recovery' but the artifact cites zero file paths (`cited_paths: "(no file paths cited in this artifact)"`), and the Acceptance line enumerates only tests/clippy/formatting/protected tests/distribution validation/restarts/socket health/signed mutations — nothing that defines what a repaired 'seam' means or how it is verified.
findings.suggested_fix: Enumerate the concrete seams (e.g., specific files under `substrate/kbd-runtime`, `substrate/sovereign-sync`, or orchestration skills) discovered during recovery, each with its own verifiable acceptance criterion.

findings.claim: Acceptance criteria do not cover constraint C-05 (bash 3.2 compatibility) despite the change exercising launchd restart paths, nor C-03 (docs update) despite scope touching skills and generated distributions.
findings.evidence: Constraint C-05: 'Any script that can be invoked by a launchd agent (macOS /bin/bash is 3.2) must avoid mapfile / declare -A. Test with /bin/bash script.sh' — the plan requires 'two launchd restarts' and repair of 'orchestration seams' but no acceptance item tests touched scripts under /bin/bash. Constraint C-03 requires docs/codex-plugin.md updates when the plugin surface changes; scope includes 'KBD orchestration skills | generated distributions' yet neither Details nor Acceptance mentions docs sync.
findings.suggested_fix: Add acceptance items: any launchd-invoked script touched by the change passes under `/bin/bash` (3.2), and — if skill/distribution sources are edited — docs/codex-plugin.md (and CLAUDE.md Codex section where relevant) updated per C-03 alongside the C-01 regeneration already covered.

findings.claim: Scope is expressed only as subsystem names with no concrete file paths, forcing the execute stage to rediscover locations the assess stage presumably already identified.
findings.evidence: Scope line reads 'kbd runtime | sovereign-sync REST/router | prometheus CLI | KBD orchestration skills | generated distributions' and `cited_paths` confirms no file paths are cited anywhere, even though the file tree contains the matching concrete roots (`substrate/kbd-runtime`, `substrate/sovereign-sync`, `tools/prometheus-cli`, `scripts/build-codex-plugin.js`).
findings.suggested_fix: Cite the concrete directories/files from the assessment so execute has an unambiguous work surface.
